name: 陳信安
objective: This course introduces engineering students the advanced mathematics in practical engineering problems, including following topics: basic engineering mathematics, the system of differential equations, Markov chain, Fourier series, partial differential equation, vector calculus and related topics.
schedule:
1. Review of calculus and engineering mathematics
2. System of differential equations
3. Markov chain
4. Fourier series
5. Partial differential equation
6. Vector calculus
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG1：消除貧窮（No Poverty）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
remarks: Up to 5 students from departments other than Department of Materials and Mineral Resources Engineering are allowed.
